title: Compare explicit states and generator bytecode
description: You can inspect three representations of the sequence 1, 2, 3 and distinguish their actual mechanisms.

steps.description: The comments sketch three yields. GeneratorState stores an integer used by the following explicit branch structure.
The state branches yield 1, 2, and 3, then return. This illustration still uses Python yield to suspend its own loop.

steps.question: Does the disassembly loop print every instruction?
steps.answer: No. It prints only instructions whose names appear in the supplied filter.

steps.description: The recording includes constants, YIELD_VALUE, RESUME, and a return instruction from original_gen. These are selected bytecode observations.
The final helper eagerly appends three values and returns a list. Its output is [1, 2, 3]; it neither stores continuations nor implements call/cc despite the surrounding labels.
